# Ayoola Damisile — Full-Stack Software Engineer & Systems Architect

> Official personal site and canonical entity home: https://www.damisile.name.ng/
> Knowledge Graph: Ayoola Damisile (/g/11ynvpcp11) • Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141703795

## Who
Ayoola Damisile (also: Damisile Ayoola, Ayoola Damisile Ayooluwa) is a Nigerian full-stack software engineer, systems architect, and open-source creator. Business Information Technology scholar at the Federal University of Technology Akure (FUTA). Sole Software Engineer who engineered BuySolar.ng (CAC: 8168912) from scratch across 682 Next.js edge routes with raw-body Paystack HMAC SHA-512 webhook reconciliation and Gemini 2.5 Flash multimodal quoting, and built the corporate platform for LIGHTSUP ENERGY SOLUTIONS (lightsupenergy.com). Author of official W3C Web Machine Learning specification security finding (Issue #288, cited by specification editors in Issue #365). Contributor to InsForge (YC W24) authoring native Paystack payment integration (PR #1965) passing 15 green CI suites. Creator of fixmcp (officially verified on Glama with Straight A's across all tools, Release 0.1.1) and @damisile_ayoola/envvault on npm. Architect of checkIn (client-side 468-point facial geometry matching via Google MediaPipe FaceMesh, Haversine formula GPS geofencing, and offline IndexedDB sync). IBM-certified Cybersecurity Architect (credential 83Z8PYF1AZ8H) with Google AI Professional credentials. Outside of software engineering, he is also an accomplished classical pianist, organist, and accompanist.
